chunks: Isma'il ibn Ishaq ibn Aban al-Warraq narrated to me, from Ja'far, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام would raise his hands in the first takbir over the funeral, then he would not do so again until he departed.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام in this narration
key_terms.أَوَّلِ التَّكْبِيرِ: The first declaration of takbir in the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْجَنَازَةِ: The funeral bier or funeral prayer context
key_terms.يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ: He raises his two hands during the prayer action
key_terms.يَنْصَرِفَ: He departs or finishes and leaves

ai.seo_question: Did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام raise his hands in every takbir of the funeral prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام in salat over the janazah, specifically that he raised his hands only in the first takbir. It serves as evidence in jurisprudential discussions on the manner of performing the funeral prayer.
